zh.name: 读者来信与专家回应
zh.summary: 先呈现经过允许的真实问题，再用清楚归属的回答和重点摘句回应。
zh.useWhen: 问题与回答有真实对应，不能代写成专家原话；区别于普通观点长文。
zh.instructions: 允许展示的问题、回答原文、回答者身份与来源
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Reader Question and Answer
en.summary: Create an Instagram opinion carousel using the reader question and answer structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the reader question and answer format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.

imageCues: 淡紫背景和深靛蓝栏目条
首屏左侧来信正文30–36px以深色短高亮条分段，右侧回应者半身肖像占45%
第二页深靛蓝底、奶油白衬线回答36–44px与同人另一姿态
第三页浅紫细网格，大衬线关键句62–78px，底部一致刊头
